data.name: Musicrab
data.detailed_description:
Have you heard about the new crab sensation that's sweeping the nation?

Step up to the challenge as you try to get Musicrab and his friends back home. Moving left and right on the screen with real crab like movement, catch bubbles and friendly aquatic companions to progress as you travel through the levels to complete your journey! Watch out for the bombs, as catching those will be met with instant demise. Make sure you catch at least 70% of all bubbles that drop or else Musicrab can't keep up the required rhythm to go on. If you feel you have a good score post it to the highscores and challenge your friends and see who can become the Musicrab champion!

Musicrab isn't alone on his journey! Using the aid of his aquatic companions is vital in your quest. Piano lobster will slow down time, Violin Horseshoe Crab will blow up bombs, and the dancing shrimps will assist you in catching the falling bubbles and extra companions! Catch enough shrimp in a row to summon the legendary shrimp train to really boost your progress. 

With 7 levels, unending gameplay, a variety of music, unlockable shell cosmetics, and secret boss levels, this game has everything you need!
